'''Turkana''' was a sparsely populated<ref name="Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Turkana system/Legends|Turkana system]] near the [[Pakuuni sector/Legends|Pakuuni sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
It was the homeworld of [[Koffi Arana]]. For some time before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] fleet had its base there. It was here, during the [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]], that the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] debuted in its' first major military role, surprising the Imperials who assaulted the fleet.
